name: repost X posts everywhere
description: Picks up new posts on X and pushes copies out to Threads, LinkedIn, Facebook and Bluesky via Post Bridge. Built on the assumption that X is where you write first and the rest are distribution — you will need a Post Bridge account connected for any of it to fire.
